prompts.fiery:
Precise edit of this APPROVED Kiana Fiery Wishing Star seated listening 12-frame sheet. Create a STRONGER, clearly readable side-to-side NOD of head and upper torso while copying the lower body of each cell exactly.
EXACTLY 12 complete characters, THREE columns by FOUR rows. Same cell placement and source resolution, full bottom row.
Movement: an easy rhythmic "dip down toward one shoulder, rise through the middle, dip down toward the other shoulder". Frames1-3: pronounced LEFT-side DOWNWARD nod, chin slightly lowered and head lowered about12–18 source pixels, upper torso inclines gently left; frames4-6 lift smoothly toward upright center; frames7-9 descend toward the other shoulder; frames10-12 clearly RIGHT-side DOWNWARD nod. The left and right dips must be unmistakably opposite: in first row the left eye in the image is lower than right; last row left eye higher than right. Head roll about12 degrees with a soft forward nod; torso inclines about6 degrees with a natural curved neck/upper spine, pelvis unmoved. A head-led body nod, not just tipping head or sliding it sideways. Keep the SAME FACE FACING as input in all12: NO yaw, NO looking left/right, NO profile, no new camera angle; both eyes remain visible and face still looks toward viewer. No neck disconnection or pasted-head seam.
ABSOLUTELY LOCK every corresponding cell's hips, seat orientation, thighs, knees, calves, shoes, lower costume, leg-swing pose, red round gold-trim flower stool, stool feet, and lower-body pixel placement. Do not change leg swing, move butt, tilt stool or rotate entire figure. Only redraw connected upper body/head/hair/headphones. Preserve original overall figure size and compact head/body proportions, do not grow or shrink head during nod.
Match input's exact silver-white hair, soft neutral gray-lavender shadows, hair shine, thin soft violet-gray contours, restrained red-black-gold palette, floral red headphones, OPEN lively purple/cyan star-glint eyes and gentle smile. Keep same eye size, brightness and high-quality painterly chibi style. No blue/gray cast, thick contours, extra saturation, dim eyes or closed-eye sleeping pose.
Whole painted animation frames, not separated movable body parts. Smooth adjacent changes, transparent gutters, complete headpieces/hair/shoes. Transparent alpha background, no shadows, glow, halo, text, additional props or background. This is a comparison-only new variant; do not redesign the approved lower body.
